name: Wireless Headphones
description: Over-ear wireless headphones with soft cushioned ear cups, clear balanced sound and up to 30 hours of battery life. Folds flat for travel.

name: Smart Watch
description: A slim smart watch with heart-rate tracking, notifications and a bright always-on display. Water resistant, with a week of battery in everyday use.

name: Wireless Mouse
description: A compact wireless mouse with a comfortable contoured shape, quiet clicks and a receiver that stores inside the body.

name: Wireless Keyboard
description: A low-profile wireless keyboard with quiet scissor keys and a full number row. Pairs with up to three devices.

name: Scented Candle
description: A hand-poured soy wax candle in a smoked glass jar, with notes of cedar and amber. Burns for around 40 hours.

name: Desk Lamp
description: An adjustable metal desk lamp with a weighted base and a matte grey finish. Takes a standard E27 bulb.

name: Potted Succulent
description: A low-maintenance succulent in a glazed ceramic pot. Happy on a bright windowsill with water every couple of weeks.

name: Accent Armchair
description: A button-tufted armchair with turned wooden legs and a deep, supportive seat. Arrives fully assembled.

name: Pendant Lamp
description: A simple enamelled pendant lamp with a 1.5 m fabric cord. Works well over a dining table or kitchen counter.

name: Insulated Water Bottle
description: A 500 ml double-walled steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12. Leak-proof screw cap.

name: Classic White T-Shirt
description: A regular-fit crew neck T-shirt in midweight organic cotton. Pre-washed so it keeps its shape.

name: Leather Jacket
description: A biker-style jacket in soft black leather with an asymmetric zip, quilted lining and three outer pockets.

name: Everyday Backpack
description: A 20-litre backpack in water-resistant canvas with a padded laptop sleeve and a quick-access front pocket.

name: Knit Poncho
description: A lightweight open-knit poncho with a fringed hem, in undyed cotton. One size.

name: Bomber Jacket
description: A lightweight bomber jacket with ribbed cuffs and hem and a two-way zip, in a warm terracotta shade.

name: Vintage Classics Set
description: A set of six clothbound classic novels, chosen for well-worn spines and good company on a shelf.

name: Hardcover Novel
description: A sewn-bound hardcover edition printed on cream paper, with a ribbon marker.

name: Paperback Bundle
description: Three paperbacks picked by our team: one novel, one essay collection and one book of short stories.

name: Facial Serum
description: A lightweight daily serum with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E, in a 30 ml amber glass dropper bottle.

name: Gentle Body Lotion
description: A fragrance-free body lotion with oat extract for dry or sensitive skin. 200 ml tube.

name: Makeup Essentials Set
description: An everyday set with a pressed powder, a blush, two lip colours and three brushes in a travel pouch.
